posts.content_md:
Hi,

I asked my local library if they had this book, they didn't, but the British Lending Library has a copy (who can lend to anyone in the UK), so they managed to get the book for me on a 6 week loan for only £2.50. (only had to wait 1 week to get it)

- So anyone in the UK can borrow this book just by going to your local library and ordering it. 

- Just an idea if you are on a tight budget like me.

Regards, Rick.
